    INT. MILLER HOUSE - NIGHT
    Tess sits on the couch, turning a folded letter
    over in her hands.
    Rain taps against the dark window.
                        TYLER
              Are you okay?
              You have been quiet since we left the station.
    Tess looks toward him.
                        TESS

                  (quietly)
              I'm fine.
              I just need a little time to think.
    Tyler stands.
                        TESS

              Don't go yet.
    She reaches for the letter.

                        TESS (V.O.)

              There are things I should have told you
              before any of this happened.
                                            CUT TO:
EXT. MILLER HOUSE - NIGHT
A car pulls into the driveway.
Its headlights sweep across the porch.
                    OFFICER (O.S.)

          Is anybody home?
Tess opens the front door.
                    TESS
          We are both here. What happened?
                    OFFICER
              (showing his badge)

          I need you to come with me.
          There are a few questions we need to ask.
He steps aside.
                    OFFICER
          Please bring the letter.
                                        DISSOLVE TO:
    INT./EXT. CAR - MOVING - NIGHT

    Tyler watches the road. The trees lean toward
    the narrow shoulder in the wind.
                        TYLER
              Did you know what was in that envelope?
    Tess looks outside.
                        TESS
              NO

    She closes her eyes.
                        TESS
                  (after a moment)
              I thought I did.
              Now I'm not so sure.
                        TYLER (O.S.)
              Then let's find out together.

                                            SMASH CUT TO:
INT. POLICE STATION - LATER
The officer sets a recorder on the table.
                    OFFICER

          Tell me what happened at the house.
Tess takes a long breath.

                    TESS

          It started before we got there.
          Before either of us knew what the letter meant.
Tyler opens the envelope.
                    TESS (CONT'D)

          There was another page.
          It's the part I couldn't show you.
                                        FADE OUT.

    EXT. FOREST - DAWN
    The road ends at a locked gate.
    Beyond it, the first light touches the trees.
                        TYLER
              We can turn back.
    Tess steps toward the gate.
                        TESS

              Not this time.
    She pushes the gate open.
                        TESS (V.O.)
              This is where the story actually begins.
                                            FADE TO BLACK.
